hints.title: Define Vowel Character Set
hints.text: Identify vowels across both lowercase and uppercase variations.

hints.title: Split String In Half
hints.text: Divide string into two equal parts of length n / 2.

hints.title: Compare Vowel Tallies
hints.text: Count vowels in the first half and compare directly against the vowel count in the second half.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def halvesAreAlike(self, s: str) -> bool:
        vowels = set("aeiouAEIOU")
        mid = len(s) // 2
        c1 = sum(1 for c in s[:mid] if c in vowels)
        c2 = sum(1 for c in s[mid:] if c in vowels)
        return c1 == c2
```

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space set lookup checks each character in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate produces clean single-pass or two-half counting logic.
